chunks: And al-Husayn al-Ahmasi narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
It is the name, and none is to be trusted with it except a Muslim.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah, the Imam transmitting the ruling
key_terms.الِاسْمُ: the name, meaning the verbal mention required in context
key_terms.مُسْلِمٌ: a Muslim, the one accepted as trustworthy in this matter

ai.seo_question: Who can be trusted to pronounce the name in matters of hunting and slaughtering?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the matter in question is the pronouncing of the name, and that only a Muslim is relied upon regarding it. In the context of hunting and slaughtering, it indicates a legal condition tied to invoking the name properly.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4183 - And Al-Husayn Al-Ahmasi narrated from Abu Abdullah (as):
"It is the (mentioning of) the name, and none is to be trusted with it except a Muslim."
